content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 means the service was denied as bundled into another paid service, not a medical-necessity issue. An appeal with medical necessity was already tried and failed. The correct remedy for a bundling denial is to submit corrected claim data with an appropriate modifier (e.g., modifier to indicate a distinct procedural service) demonstrating separate payability, so correct_and_resubmit is the proper progression. Timely filing still has 27 days of runway.","action":"correct_and_resubmit"}
